extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia contributors or users attempting to create a new article
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for creating or diagnosing why a specific Wikipedia article page (e.g., 'Eddie Murphy Comeback') does not exist, including account requirements, search/redirect checks, and troubleshooting for recently created or deleted pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmed requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users must be logged in and autoconfirmed before creating pages; if not autoconfirmed, use alternate submission paths (see article wizard / request a new article).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or request a new article
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot create the page directly (e.g., not autoconfirmed), submit a draft via the article wizard or make a request for a new article so others can review/create it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search existing articles for title alternatives
rubrics_metrics.description: Please search for 'Eddie Murphy Comeback' in existing articles to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a new page, check whether the content already exists under a different title or spelling to avoid duplication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check for pages linking to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Inspect inbound links to discover related or existing coverage that might use a different title or to find appropriate place(s) for content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recently created page may be delayed / try purge
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you recently created the page and don't see it, wait briefly for database updates or use the purge function to refresh the page cache.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title capitalization sensitivity and redirect suggestion
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify capitalization variants (except first character) and, where appropriate, create redirects from alternative capitalizations to the canonical title.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check deletion log if page was deleted
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult the deletion log to learn why a page was removed and what (if anything) can be done to address deletion reasons before re-creating or requesting recreation.
